* Transient Requirement tr_reg: Meet target Vout across line (Vin) and load changes
tran 4e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
meas tran Vout_avg avg v(n3) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_avg
meas tran Vout_ripple_vpp pp v(n3) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_ripple_vpp
meas tran Vin_avg avg v(n0) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vin_avg
meas tran Iout_avg avg i(vr_load_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Iout_avg
let VIN = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_VIN.csv v(n0)
let VOUT = v(n3)
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_VOUT.csv v(n3)
let v_SW_auto = v(n0) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_SW.csv v_SW_auto
wrdata time_series/I_SW.csv i(VSW_SENSE)
let v_SW_gate_auto = v(n1) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW.csv v_SW_gate_auto
let v_D_auto = 0 - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_D.csv v_D_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D.csv i(VD_SENSE)
let v_L1_auto = v(n2) - v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_L1.csv v_L1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_L1.csv i(VL1_SENSE)
let v_Cout_auto = v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_Cout.csv v_Cout_auto
wrdata time_series/I_Cout.csv i(VCout_SENSE)
let v_R_LOAD_auto = v(n3)

let PWM_gate_diff = v(n1) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM.csv PWM_gate_diff
plot v(n0) title 'tr_reg_VIN'
plot v(n3) title 'tr_reg_VOUT'
plot v_SW_auto title 'V_SW'
plot i(VSW_SENSE) title 'I_SW'
plot v_SW_gate_auto title 'Gate_SW'
plot v_D_auto title 'V_D'
plot i(VD_SENSE) title 'I_D'
plot v_L1_auto title 'V_L1'
plot i(VL1_SENSE) title 'I_L1'
plot v_Cout_auto title 'V_Cout'
plot i(VCout_SENSE) title 'I_Cout'
plot v_R_LOAD_auto title 'V_R_LOAD'
plot i(VR_LOAD_SENSE) title 'I_R_LOAD'
plot PWM_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM'

* Transient Requirement tr_dyn: Dynamic response: step changes (line/load) with minimal overshoot and fast settling
tran 1e-06 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
meas tran Vout_max max v(n3) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_max
meas tran Vout_min min v(n3) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_min
meas tran rise_time_10_90 TRIG v(n3) VAL=0.5 RISE=1 TARG v(n3) VAL=4.5 RISE=1
print rise_time_10_90
meas tran settle_to_upper TRIG AT=1e-6 TARG v(n3) VAL=5.05 CROSS=LAST
print settle_to_upper
meas tran settle_to_lower TRIG AT=1e-6 TARG v(n3) VAL=4.95 CROSS=LAST
print settle_to_lower
meas tran IL_peak max i(vl1_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print IL_peak
meas tran IL_ripple pp i(vl1_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print IL_ripple
meas tran Vsw_overshoot max v(n0) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vsw_overshoot
wrdata time_series/tr_dyn_IL.csv i(vl1_sense)
let VSW = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/tr_dyn_VSW.csv v(n0)
let PWM_gate_diff = v(n1) - v(n2)

plot i(vl1_sense) title 'tr_dyn_IL'
plot v(n0) title 'tr_dyn_VSW'
plot PWM_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM'

* Transient Requirement tr_eff: Efficiency across load points with loss breakdown
tran 1e-06 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
meas tran Iin_avg avg i(vin) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Iin_avg
meas tran Iout_avg avg i(vr_load_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Iout_avg

print Vout_avg
meas tran Vin_avg avg v(n0) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vin_avg
meas tran Vsw_source_avg avg v(n2) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vsw_source_avg
meas tran Vsw_drain_avg avg v(n0) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vsw_drain_avg
meas tran Isw_avg avg i(vsw_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Isw_avg
meas tran Vd_avg avg v(n2) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vd_avg
meas tran Id_avg avg i(vd_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Id_avg
meas tran IL1_rms rms i(vl1_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print IL1_rms
meas tran Icout_rms rms i(vcout_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Icout_rms
wrdata time_series/tr_eff_IIN.csv i(vin)

plot i(vin) title 'tr_eff_IIN'
plot i(vsw_sense) title 'tr_eff_ISW'
plot PWM_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM'

linearize

print Vsw_max

print IL_rms

print IL_ripple

print Isw_peak
meas tran Isw_rms rms i(vsw_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Isw_rms
